x-card.description: Indices and records of Algolia: search with filters and facets, records by objectID. Record writes and deletes wait for approval.

applicationId.title: Application ID
applicationId.description: Your Algolia application's ID (Dashboard › Settings › API Keys).

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Stored encrypted by GateRook. Prefer the Search API key, or a key with search, browse and listIndexes only, unless agents should write.

indexes.title: Indices
indexes.description: The indexes agents may use; * matches any characters, such as products_*. Empty: every index the credentials see.
